title: Provide a button to end a process that is blocking unmount
line: When a device can't be safely removed because apps still use it, Disks & Devices now offers "End Blocking Processes and Remove".
explanation: When safely removing a device failed because files on it were open, the Disks & Devices widget listed the blocking apps (found with lsof) but offered no way to deal with them, so users had to find and close them by hand. The change adds an "End Blocking Processes and Remove" action ("…and Eject" for discs) to the device's expanded actions, shown only after a removal failed with "device busy". It looks up the processes with lsof again, sends them SIGTERM, sends SIGKILL to any still running after 3 seconds (interactive shells ignore SIGTERM), never touches plasmashell itself, and then tries the removal again; if it's still busy the usual message comes back.

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: offer to end the processes blocking removal

When a device can't be removed because files on it are still open, the
widget names the apps but leaves the user to find and close them. Add an
action that ends those processes and then removes the device again.

BUG: 475242

media.caption: Today: removal fails, the widget names tail and bash, but the only action is Open with File Manager
With the change: the expanded device offers End Blocking Processes and Remove
After clicking it: tail and the Konsole shell are ended and the stick can be safely removed
Whole flow: Safely remove fails, End Blocking Processes and Remove, device removed
